== Biography ==
Margaret was baptized on 10-Aug-1712 in Kilwinning. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2463|John Glasgow]] and [[Wyllie-1044|Jean Wyllie]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1065]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Margaret’s 1712 Laigh Fergushill entry names John Glasgow and Jean Wyllie, the same couple and residence as Matthew 1715. The repeated household is strong, while the father’s identification with the 1683 child remains inferred.

Literal recorded father is near-certain; confidence includes the selected father account’s childhood identity, not Margaret’s later identity.

Next useful test: Compare original p87 with 1715 p111 and the Wyllie marriage; resolve uncertain August baptism day.
